en: Do you remember where you saw them?
Pretty sure they were hangin' out right in the middle of Nagasu Boulevard.
Understood. Thanks for your time.
Sure thing. Just, stay safe out there, okay?
Huh. Wonder if they were Yahata Family...
Sorry, did you just say Yahata? Did you see them?
Pretty sure, yeah. They were wearing those awful red tracksuits and everythin'.
Where were they?
Standin' smack-dab in the middle of Nagasu Boulevard. Can't say why.
Got it, thanks.
Hey, you aren't thinkin' about goin' after them, are ya? That's a one-way street to a hospital bed, if y'ask me.
Boy, I know they're bad news, but those Yahata Family guys sure look cool in their red tracksuits...
Did you see some Yahata Family crew around here?
Yeah. They were at the east end of Modern Street, where it meets the river.
I see. Thanks.
Who are those people in the red tracksuits?
There must be some kind of event going on. One of those hero shows for kids, maybe. It's just a costume.
Excuse me. Did you say you saw some people wearing red tracksuits?
Yes, that's right. Is there a festival going on?
Hardly. They're yakuza, so you should keep your distance. Can you tell me where you saw them?
Yakuza!? Oh my! I did wonder why they looked so scary. So it wasn't a kid's event, then?
They were on the east end of... I think it's called New Street? Modern Street? Something like that.
I'll figure it out. Thanks.
Not a problem!

en: Let's go home. I'm telling ya, it's dangerous.
Oh, c'mon. It's the Yahata Family! Y'don't get to see real yakuza every day. Let's go look!
But what if they come after us!?
Did you just say something about the Yahata Family?
Eep! Please don't hurt me!
Calm down. I just want to know where they were.
On the east side of town, way down at the end of Chikuzengawa Street.
Got it. Thanks.
...Phew, that just about scared the soul outta me.
I guess those were Yahata Family men...
Huh? Yeah. They were wearing their usual getup, so I'm pretty sure.
Down at the south end of Chikuzengawa Street.
I see. Thanks for your time.
Those fucking Yahata Family punks, walking around like they own the place.
Did you see some Yahata Family crew around?
Yeah, that's right. What's it to you?
Down at the south end of Chikuzengawa Street. Don't tell me you run with them, too.
Don't worry, I don't. Thanks for your help.
It looks like all the yakuza left town, and outta the blue, too.
What's goin' on? Maybe they're all going somewhere for somethin'.
Man, that was amazin'. Never seen that many fancy black cars in a row.
I wonder where they were going. Maybe they were shootin' a commercial or something.
The year's over already. Time flies, huh?
Yeah. I guess it's already more than six months since Deputy Police Commissioner Munakata's suicide.
Huh? I don't remember that.
This year's been a disaster for the Tojo Clan.
Yeah. Taken unawares by a minor group like the Ueno Seiwa Clan and all that. Guess the shine's starting to come off their outfit.
Well, that just gives us a chance to claw our way up, huh?
Yeah. Things could start heating up soon.
The Tojo Sixth Chairman ain't all that, huh?
Yeah. He came in with the backin' of the fourth chairman, but after his weak-ass handlin' of the Ueno thing, I'm guessin' he's outta his depth.
Ain't that the truth? Guess we gotta rethink our positions, too.
Another year over. What were the big news stories this year, Ma-kun?
Let me see... I guess that money that came raining down from Millennium Tower was the biggest headline.
Oh yeah! That was the day we had our first date, wasn't it? It was almost like the gods were sending us a sign. So romantic, wasn't it?
Sure. Watching you crawling around scraping up 10,000 yen bills like an animal left quite the impression...
I drank way too much. I need a workout to sober up.
Batting center might be good for that. It's just over in the Hotel District.
That new guy, Kugihara, is just straight-up crazy.
I got up to my fair share of mischief to get put away in here, but I bet he did worse.
That guy Kugihara didn't waste any time finding himself a crew. He's got quite a following.
I wonder if it's all his own doing, or something he planned from the beginning. Best to keep an eye on that one, I reckon.
That fucking Deputy Warden Kosaka denied my parole request!
What the hell did I do wrong!? That bastard screwed me over!
You made a name for yourself on the outside, but that don't mean shit in here.
The deputy warden, Kosaka, hates yakuza with a passion. With all you've been up to, you're public enemy number one in his eyes. Heheh.
Exercise time again. If I have to stay outside dressed like this much longer, I'm going to freeze to death!
Fucking exercise time! The cold'll be the death of me if I have to stay out here.
Terrible food, biting cold, and cellmates you can't trust as far as you can throw.
I know I only have myself to blame, but this is hell on Earth.
Still, I guess it's better than Okinawa Penitentiary No. 2. Hah. Now I'm comparing it to some place that might not even exist.
Even in here, some guys find a way to smoke. I guess that shows there's cracks in the system.
All sorts of items and information slip through.
This is too much. I've been dreaming of gourmet dinners every night. Then I wake up to whatever this is.
Maybe I'll get used to it.
They say the road into town is finally clear.
There's no reason for you to stay here now. You should get out of here as soon as you can.
You're the one Okudera-san brought back, huh?
Normally I'd tell you to move on as soon as you can, but the road into town is closed because of the snow.
You just stay out of trouble until the road is clear, now. No idea how long that'll take, though.
You're that guy staying with Okudera-san, right?
Why'd you come up to the mountains? You don't look like you came to hunt. Nobody in the village has seen you before, either.
Uh, I usually hunt in a different area.
No kidding? Well, the road is snowed over, so you're stuck here for a while.
We don't have TV, there's no radio reception, and we don't get newspapers. You'll probably be bored out of your skull, but just sit tight.
Okay. Got it.
(No TV or newspapers, huh? Lucky for me. The prison break's probably all over the news.)
There are cops everywhere. Is all this just 'cause someone broke out of prison? Ugh. Wish they'd lower our taxes if they're just gonna waste their money on this circus.
There are so many policemen around. I wonder what happened...
Oh, gosh, maybe there's some violent criminal lurking about... I'd better hurry home!
I heard there's an escaped prisoner on the run.
Seriously!? This is totally like a real-life action movie! No wonder the cops are out in force.
What if the prisoner took us hostage!? Do you think my parents would pay the ransom?
I heard there's a prisoner on the loose. You don't think they'd cancel the snow festival because of that, do you!?
I'm trying to get my boyfriend to propose to me there. I hope they get that prisoner behind bars again soon!
Damn, the economy is in a bad way. All my old haunts are shutting down one by one.
That bar across the street, Polaris? One of my absolute favorites.
And now, it's gone. Whole building, empty as my heart. This town is falling apart.
Where's a good place to get a drink around here?
Let me see... There's a nice bar called Ambitious over on Lavender Street.
They have dart boards and a pool table, too. I love the atmosphere over there.
That sounds good. I'll give it a try!
Did ya see round two?
'Course I did! Haruka Sawamura won, huh? I thought she just faked her way in, but she might actually have a shot.
Yeah, she aced it! Who's gonna win the final round, though!? Man, how am I supposed to focus on homework when this stuff's goin on!?
Not like you were gonna do that homework, anyway. I feel you, though.
'Course I did! I knew T-Set'd take it. Haruka Sawamura did okay, but wasn't quite as polished, y'know?
I guess the next one's the last one. How'm I supposed to get my homework done when this stuff's goin' on!?
So the P. League finals started, huh?
Oh, the Princess League? Yeah, I saw that. Haruka Sawamura took the win. I was sure T-Set was gonna blow her away.
Ya think she's actually got a shot at winnin'?
Nah, I doubt it. I still get the feelin' T-Set'll come out on top in the end.
Oh, the Princess League? Yeah, I saw that. Haruka Sawamura took the win. T-Set's gonna be pretty hard to beat.
But there's two more rounds, so Haruka Sawamura's still got a shot, right?
Did ya see the Princess League the other day? The competition's gettin' pretty fierce!
Yeah, that was crazy. I was sure Haruka Sawamura was gonna lose, but she pulled a big comeback at the end.
It's the finals next, right? Think she's gonna win the whole thing?
Oh, come on. It's gotta be T-Set. No way they're gonna lose.
What did you think of round two?
Heh, the one your "future wife" Sawamura-san was in? She sure put on a fine performance.
Hell yeah she did! And your future wives were the girls of T-Set, if I'm remembering right. They did good, too. Almost enough to win me over.
Ha ha, very funny. You know it's gonna be my lovely T-Set that seals the deal in the end, though.
Was that supposed to be a joke? 'Cause it wasn't very funny. Man, I can see it already... My precious Haruka, basking in glorious victory...
Hehehe...
Hahaha...
Heh, the one your "future wife" Sawamura-san was in? She put up a good fight against my lovely T-Set. So close, and yet so far.
Heh, ain't that the truth. I didn't expect your T-Set to push my lovely wife Haruka aside... But mark my words, she will take the win in the end.
Did ya see the Princess League finals?
Yeah, Haruka Sawamura won, right?
That's my girl! She's really got a shot now.
Ya think? I've still got my money on T-Set. They just had a minor slip-up this time, that's all.
No way, Haruka's got it clinched! Man, my future wife's gonna make her major debut... I should start thinking about how to pop the question.
Yeah, T-Set brought it home, huh?
But my Haruka's gonna make a comeback!
Ya think? I'm sure T-Set's gonna nail it. Haruka's just been lucky, and that luck's about to run out.
Whaddya mean? Haruka's gonna own it! No doubt!
Did ya see the Princess League the other day?
Yeah. Got a glimpse of Haruka's bra for a sec.
No way! Seriously? I hadn't heard about that.
Look it up online. Everyone's talking 'bout it. Yeah, that's gotta be her bra, all right.
I don't believe it! They're sullyin' my future wife's perfect image! Better check it out myself, just to make sure they're not tellin' lies about her...
Did you watch the P. League, Chikamura-san?
P. League? Oh, the Princess League? Yeah, I did. They were dancin' like maniacs.
Well, the dancin's part of the performance, ya know.
My daughter's too caught up in the excitement to get her homework done. Not like she was ever good at getting it done before...
No kidding...
Man, my daughter was buggin' me to watch that princess thing, so I finally sat down and caught an episode.
The P. League?
What's the P. League?
It's short for Princess League. How'd you like it?
Well, it was all a bit much for me. Girls these days dress up too flashy for my likin'.
Really? Which of the competitors was more your type?
What!? They're young enough to be my daughters. Don't be disgusting.
My daughter's hooked on that princess thing on TV. Can't shut up about it.
Oh, the P. League?
It's short for Princess League. That's what the fans are calling it these days.
Huh. Hard for an old guy like me to keep up. My daughter said something about a tea set?
I think she means the group, T-Set. They're in the running to win the P. League finals.
Win what? It's a competition? I'm gettin' too old for this shit.
It's the last stage of the Princess League now, huh?
Man, that stern look T-Set always has on their faces drives me crazy. I'd pay a million yen for sixty seconds of verbal abuse from those beauties...
Too much information, bro... What about that Haruka Sawamura?
Yeah, she's always lookin' like a wide-eyed doe. She ain't got the same cold stare. Doesn't do it for me.
Uh... Okay, then.
The P. League finals started, right?
The Princess League? Those T-Set girls were shootin' some terrifying looks from the stage. Man, what I wouldn't do to spend five minutes under the soles of their boots...
